description: Rīgas vietējais ģeodēziskais tīkls is a dataset listed in data.gov.lv, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Rīgas dome. The data set shall contain information on the points of the local geodetic network of Riga, their protection zones and the geodetic network scheme. The data are maintained in the Latvian 1992 coordinate system (LKS-92 TM) with a scale of 1:500 precision. Coverage: Rīgas dome. The portal shows the English title as "Local Geodetic Network of Riga" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Rīgas dome. Its keywords include Ģeodēzija, Vietējais tīkls, Rīgas Dome, Aizsargjoslas, Aizsargjoslas ap ģeodēzisko punktu, Tīkla punkti. The listing shows 6 download or service links in DXF, GPKG, KML. The listing shows 2024-07-10 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-data-gov-lv.
